name: s8_layer_sweep
title: Oracle Lens carries the state and never names it, at every layer from 20 to 60
caption: Oracle Lens at its twelve read layers (20 to 60 step 4, plus 42), exp 22 public bank, 160 items per row (80 marked, 80 unmarked). Upper three lines: median over the four readable structural rows (Python and JavaScript strings, LaTeX math, JSON depth), band = min to max of those rows; no per-item scores were saved, so the AUROC lines carry no CI (per-row Hanley-McNeil intervals in the backup). Dotted line: strict regex naming rate pooled over all seven structural rows (n = 1,120 readouts per layer), Wilson 95% band. The Markdown rows are omitted from the upper lines because the probe reads them at only 0.49 to 0.78; they carry about 0.6 and 0.5 and are named in at most 2% of readouts (backup).

notes: Carries = Oracle Lens k=1 free readout at the layer, rebuilt by the NLA reconstructor, scored by exp 14's frozen probe against the TRUE layer-42 activations. Prompted = exp 22's frozen phrasings, max of mean-of-three and fixed-label AUROC. Names recounted here from the ol26 readouts with lib26.NAME_RE (exp 23 state regexes; call argument ordinal-argument regex; code language language-name regex); identical to sweep26 'names' in all 96 cells. Record discrepancy: RESULTS.md says P1's Markdown half holds, but the prediction was 'near 0.6 at every layer' and Markdown heading level reaches 0.77 (layer 20) and 0.78 (layer 32); partial at best. Layer 42 is off Oracle Lens's trained grid and read with the carrier saying 'layer 42' (exp 22's convention).
